title: Tensorion: A Tensor-Aware Generalization of the Muon Optimizer
abstract: arXiv:2606.25975v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Common first-order optimizers, such as Adam, implicitly treat each parameter block as an unstructured vector, which disregards the multilinear weight structure present in many modern machine learning models. Recent work has shown that exploiting matrix structure can improve optimization dynamics. A notable example is Muon, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm constraint. We take the next step and introduce Tensorion, a tensor-aware optimizer that extends Muon's constrained optimization perspective from matrices to higher-order tensors. Tensorion is built around a linear minimization oracle (LMO) over a tensor norm ball. The norm is carefully chosen to balance two objectives: tightly bounding the tensor spectral norm, while still keeping the LMO tractable. translated_title: Tensorion：一种张量感知的Muon优化器泛化方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.25975v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：常见的二阶优化器（如Adam）隐式地将每个参数块视为非结构化向量，这忽略了现代机器学习模型中普遍存在的多线性权重结构。近期研究表明，利用矩阵结构可以改善优化动力学。一个显著例子是Muon，它在谱范数约束下执行最陡下降。我们进一步提出Tensorion，一种张量感知优化器，将Muon的约束优化视角从矩阵扩展到高阶张量。Tensorion围绕一个张量范数球上的线性最小化预言（LMO）构建。该范数经过精心选择，以平衡两个目标：紧密界定张量谱范数，同时保持LMO可处理。该LMO变得可计算，因为它简化为对自适应选择的展开矩阵的操作。值得注意的是，当限制到二阶张量（即矩阵）时，它退化为Muon优化器。
tldr: Tensorion是一种将Muon优化器的谱范数约束最陡下降方法从矩阵推广到高阶张量的新优化器，通过精心设计的张量范数球上的线性最小化预言，在保持计算可行性的同时紧密界定张量谱范数。
en_tdlr: Tensorion is a novel optimizer that extends Muon's spectral-norm-constrained steepest descent from matrices to higher-order tensors, using a carefully designed linear minimization oracle over a tensor norm ball to tightly bound the tensor spectral norm while remaining computationally tractable.
